name: Looking Back
overview: Scripture warns against looking back with regret or longing for the past, as seen in the tragic example of Lot's wife who became a pillar of salt for looking back (Genesis 19:26). Instead, believers are called to trust God's plans for a hopeful future, not dwelling on former days or old things (Ecclesiastes 7:10; Isaiah 43:18; Jeremiah 29:11). Jesus emphasizes the necessity of wholehearted commitment to following Him, declaring that no one who looks back after putting their hand to the plough is fit for the kingdom of God (Luke 9:62), highlighting the cost of divided devotion.
